calls.statement:
SELECT store_key, store_id, store_name
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_id = 108 AND is_current = TRUE

SELECT
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.store_key = 13
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'

SELECT
  MIN(d.calendar_date) as period_start,
  MAX(d.calendar_date) as period_end,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.calendar_date) as days_in_period
FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13

SELECT
  COALESCE(f.staff_purchase_flag, false) as is_staff_purchase,
  COUNT(*) as sale_lines,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.store_key = 13
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
GROUP BY COALESCE(f.staff_purchase_flag, false)

SELECT
  s.store_name,
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.store_key = 13
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
